headline: Executive order signed April 24, 2025, aimed at expanding US access to critical minerals and other resources found offshore.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order directs the federal government to promote finding and developing critical minerals and other resources in offshore areas, likely including the ocean floor. Critical minerals are materials used in products like batteries, electronics, and defense equipment. No official summary was provided, so details about specific agency actions, permits, or deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Companies that explore for or mine minerals offshore
who_it_affects.how: They may see federal action intended to open or speed up access to offshore mineral resources.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that manage ocean areas and resources
who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to take steps to support offshore mineral and resource development.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 24, 2025; executive orders generally take effect when signed, though specific follow-up deadlines are not given in the available information.
